pageDesc: Unlock AI match analyses with credits: packages, free credits, a sample analysis from a real match and a step-by-step guide.
heroSub: Unlock each analysis for yourself with 1 credit; it stays unlocked for you. Analyses become free for everyone after the match.
signInNote: Sign in to see your balance.

faqItems.q1: When will the payment system be active?
faqItems.a1: We're working on payment integration — it'll be live very soon.
faqItems.q2: Do I pay again for an analysis I've unlocked?
faqItems.a2: No. Analyses you unlock stay unlocked on your account; reopening is free.
faqItems.a3: No, credits stay on your account indefinitely.
faqItems.q4: Do credits depend on whether a prediction is right?
faqItems.a4: No. Credits are only for unlocking analyses; there is no gain or refund tied to match results or predictions.
faqItems.a1Live: Pick a package, tick the consent box and pay by card on Hikie's secure payment page. Credits are added to your account as soon as the payment is confirmed.

free1: Sign-up bonus: 2 credits once you verify your email.
free2: Unlock 1 ready analysis for free every week (verified email, account at least 1 day old).
free3: Analyses of finished matches are free for everyone.

sample.title: A real match: what the AI said, what happened
sample.desc: This analysis was generated before kick-off; it's public now because the match has ended. Analyses you unlock with credits look exactly like this.

guide.title: Step by step: how to use AI analysis
guide.s1Desc: Verify your email and get 2 credits. You can also unlock 1 ready analysis for free every week.
guide.s2Desc: Open the page of a match that hasn't started yet, from the home page or search.
guide.s3Title: Go to the AI Analysis tab
guide.s3Desc: The AI Analysis tab on the match page shows a short summary and the main probability for free.
guide.s4Desc: If an analysis is ready it opens right away; otherwise it's generated for 1 credit before kick-off. Analyses you unlock stay unlocked.
guide.s5Desc: Result probabilities, goal expectations, tactical profiles, heatmap and risk level. The sample alongside is a full analysis.
guide.s6Desc: When the match ends, each prediction gets a ✓ / ✗ badge. The overall hit rate is on the AI Accuracy page.
